target_estimand: 100 * (Model16D steady active stress at target ATP/Pi divided by steady active stress at baseline ATP/Pi - 1), in percent
exclusions: Exclude every added protocol measured at condition X when predicting the future response at that same condition X; this conservative condition-level rule prevents target leakage and non-future co-measurement.
Do not use any held-out target observation in the corresponding profile likelihood, fit selection, scaling, or endpoint search.
Use only the baseline observations plus the single listed added-measurement protocol for each A cell.

likelihood.loss: sum of squared residuals standardized by the published group SEMs
likelihood.covariance: diagonal working covariance: independent real/imaginary parts, frequencies, conditions, and stress blocks
likelihood.interpretation: Conditional working likelihood; group SEMs are not individual measurement-noise estimates and cross-condition covariance is unavailable.

domains.coordinate_definition: log transform for every parameter except Ks (index 9), which is scaled linearly by 45; intersect with frozen Model16D global parameter bounds.
domains.interpretation: Formal bounded-domain sensitivity boxes, not biological priors.

E_parameter_information.base_point: baseline-only constrained MLE within each frozen domain
E_parameter_information.jacobian: central finite differences in unit-scaled domain coordinates; one-sided at boundaries
E_parameter_information.prediction_objective: delta-method variance of each q_delta_stress target under inverse regularized Fisher information

F_multi_target.primary_utility: relative support-width reduction percentage from A
F_multi_target.primary_common_action_set: The four candidate protocols at ATP0.1 or Pi0; each is admissible for both ATP1 and Pi5.
F_multi_target.default_target_weights: equal for the prespecified ATP1 and Pi5 targets in the primary robust decision; full four-target summaries are secondary and report each action's eligible-target count
F_multi_target.sensitivity_utility: absolute support-width reduction in q percentage points
F_multi_target.measurement_cost: Report 1-scalar stress assays separately from 34-scalar CM spectra; no acquisition-time or monetary cost is available, so do not call the utility-only winner cost-optimal.

J_controls.utility_evaluation: prospective model-generated expected response at the baseline-only fitted point; no random measurement noise in the primary deterministic scenario; same target admissibility and likelihood cutoffs across choices
J_controls.repeat_baseline: one additional independent baseline-stress assay with group SEM equal to the published baseline stress SEM; expected value set to the fitted baseline stress, treated as a prospective model-generated control
J_controls.interpretation: Design scenario only; not an observed replication, external validation, held-out prediction, or calibrated interval result.

independent_validation: separate objective and q calculation from the forward model
analytic sign and inclusion sanity checks
rank/utility recomputation from raw branch rows
